aboutGame.title: What is Build a Car Collection?
paragraphs: Build a Car Collection is a Roblox collection simulator from Fountain Entertainment where the goal is simple to state and hard to master: grow a garage full of rare and expensive cars. Cars are offered to you and you accept or decline each one, earning in-game money and expanding your personal collection.

Progress is about more than buying the flashiest supercar first. You build income, unlock extra floors for more display space, chase Diamond Cars, and eventually take on Prestige to reset your garage for long-term rewards. Our wiki maps that whole loop with beginner steps, money routes, and car guidance.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about Build a Car Collection, from the gameplay loop and collection tips to cars, Prestige, and floors.

items.question: What is Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Build a Car Collection is a Roblox collection simulator by Fountain Entertainment. Cars are offered to you and you accept or decline each one, earn in-game money, expand your collection, unlock more cars and more floors, and hunt rare and expensive supercars.

items.question: How do I earn money fast in Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Pick one high-payout activity and repeat it every session, then reinvest roughly half of your income into the next car while keeping a reserve for upgrades and repairs.

items.question: Are there codes in Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: There is no documented code system in Build a Car Collection. The official game description does not advertise codes. Any code claims you see should be treated as unverified unless confirmed by the developer.

items.question: What are Diamond Cars in Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Diamond Cars are premium collectibles that sit above standard vehicles in rarity and collection value. New ones arrive with major Build a Car Collection content updates.

items.question: When should I Prestige in Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Prestige in Build a Car Collection is best attempted once your income loop is stable and repeatable, so the reset rewards feel like progress rather than a setback.

items.question: How do I unlock more floors in Build a Car Collection?
items.answer: Floors unlock as you grow your collection and hit in-game milestones. Extra floors give you more display space for the rare cars you collect in Build a Car Collection.
